strict_matches_only.description: `true` matches only on the dimension you searched. `false` also follows the buyer's other key (their mailing address for a name search, their name for an address search), which returns more deals with a higher risk of false positives.

property_address.description: The address of a property the buyer bought, exactly as it came back: the `address` of a `/v1/buyer-search` result, or of a purchase on a CRM deal. Pass it with `buyer_type` instead of `search_string` to get exactly that buyer, with no name to match.
property_address.title: Property Address

buyer_type.description: The buyer type that came with `property_address`.

deal_type.description: Only the buyer's flips, or only their rentals.
deal_type.title: Deal Type

lookback_months.description: Only deals the buyer bought within this many months, from 1 to 120. A flip counts from its purchase, not its sale.

subject_property_details.description: Describe the subject property to get ranked comps. Every field is optional: send what you know, even `{}`. When this object is omitted, results are not ranked.

InvestorBaseAPIKeyCredential.x-credential-instructions: Copy your subscriber API key from Account → Integrations. For an enterprise key issued by InvestorBase, choose Enterprise and enter your registered end-user ID for property data requests. Enterprise account management needs an enterprise key. NoClick reads usage (subscriber) or account details (enterprise) to verify the connection.

search_string.description: The partial address or location to search for.
search_string.title: Search String

address.description: Full street address of the subject property, in the same format `/v1/autocomplete` returns. Preferred over coordinates: we resolve it to the property, which keeps repeat detection and usage tracking accurate. When both are sent, the address wins, and the coordinates are used only if the address cannot be resolved.
address.title: Address

latitude.description: Latitude of the subject, in decimal degrees. Send it together with `longitude`. Required when no `address` is sent.
latitude.title: Latitude

longitude.description: Longitude of the subject, in decimal degrees. Send it together with `latitude`. Required when no `address` is sent.
longitude.title: Longitude

property_types.description: Property types to include: `SFR` single family, `MFR` multifamily, `CONDO` condominium, `MOBILE` mobile or manufactured home, `LAND` vacant land, `OTHER` commercial and other properties. Omitted, null or empty means `SFR`, `CONDO`, `MOBILE` and `MFR`, as in the app.
property_types.title: Property Types

buyer_types.description: Buyer types to include. Omitted, null or empty means both.
buyer_types.title: Buyer Types

radius_miles.description: How far from the subject to look, in miles, up to 10. Omitted or null means 2 miles.
radius_miles.title: Radius Miles

lookback_years.description: How far back to look for purchases, in years, up to 5. Fractions work: `0.25` is 3 months. Omitted or null means 2 years.
lookback_years.title: Lookback Years

min_bedrooms.description: Fewest bedrooms on the buyer's property. Omitted or null means no minimum.
min_bedrooms.title: Min Bedrooms

max_bedrooms.description: Most bedrooms on the buyer's property. Omitted or null means no maximum.
max_bedrooms.title: Max Bedrooms

min_bathrooms.description: Fewest bathrooms on the buyer's property. Omitted or null means no minimum.
min_bathrooms.title: Min Bathrooms

max_bathrooms.description: Most bathrooms on the buyer's property. Omitted or null means no maximum.
max_bathrooms.title: Max Bathrooms

min_purchase_price.description: Lowest price, in dollars, the buyer paid for the property. Omitted or null means no minimum.
min_purchase_price.title: Min Purchase Price

max_purchase_price.description: Highest price, in dollars, the buyer paid for the property. Omitted or null means no maximum.
max_purchase_price.title: Max Purchase Price

hide_non_arms_length.description: Leaves out purchases that were not made on the open market, such as transfers between relatives. Omitted or null means `true`.
hide_non_arms_length.title: Hide Non Arms Length

hide_hedge_fund.description: Leaves out large institutional landlords. Omitted or null means `true`.
hide_hedge_fund.title: Hide Hedge Fund

hide_no_phone.description: Leaves out buyers without a phone number after skiptracing. Omitted or null means `false`.
hide_no_phone.title: Hide No Phone

min_portfolio_size.description: Only buyers who still hold at least this many properties, as `portfolio_size` reports, so it also leaves out buyers with no portfolio on record and most flippers. A high minimum can return fewer buyers than `limit`. Omitted or null means no minimum.
min_portfolio_size.title: Min Portfolio Size

limit.description: Most buyers to return, from 1 to 100: the nearest ones, ranked among themselves. The search may return fewer. A smaller limit comes back faster and still counts as one search.
limit.title: Limit

create_deal.description: Creates the deal for the searched property in your CRM and attaches the buyers found, the same as a search in the app. Searching the same address again reuses its deal. Only applies to a search by `address`. Omitted or null means `true`; send `false` to skip it.
create_deal.title: Create Deal

async.description: When true, the request returns `202` with a `search_id` right away and the search runs in the background. Get the outcome from `GET /v1/buyer-search` or `webhook_url`.
async.title: Async

webhook_url.description: An https URL we POST the outcome to when the search completes or fails. Works in sync and async modes.
webhook_url.title: Webhook Url

webhook_secret.description: Sent back as the `x-webhook-secret` header on webhook calls, so you can verify they came from InvestorBase.
webhook_secret.title: Webhook Secret

results_in_webhook.description: When true, the completed webhook includes the full results array.
results_in_webhook.title: Results In Webhook
